justification: Both surfaces depict standing human figures rendered by incision, some with raised or forward-extended arms, which is a very generic correspondence. A shows a few large, stick-like, outline-free schematic bodies scattered freely with no framing, while B shows small, proportioned figures in profile with garments, held implements and offering tables, organised into registers separated by ruled bands and accompanied by sign-like symbols — a fundamentally different compositional and stylistic scheme.
